instructions: Verified decision list. Find a line whose stated field conditions all match the input, then return its label. Unstated fields can have any value. Matching lines agree.
If action=change, context=sandbox, risk=FALSE, return allow.
If action=change, context=partner, risk=FALSE, return allow.
If action=approve, context=partner, risk=FALSE, return allow.
If action=change, risk=FALSE, role=guest, return allow.
If action=change, risk=FALSE, role=admin, return allow.
If context=partner, risk=FALSE, role=operator, return allow.
If context=partner, risk=FALSE, role=admin, return allow.
If action=change, context=partner, risk=UNKNOWN, role=guest, return allow.
If action=change, context=partner, risk=UNKNOWN, role=admin, return allow.
If action=change, context=internal, risk=UNKNOWN, role=guest, return allow.
If action=change, context=internal, risk=UNKNOWN, role=admin, return allow.
If action=approve, context=partner, risk=UNKNOWN, role=guest, return allow.
If action=approve, context=partner, risk=UNKNOWN, role=admin, return allow.
If action=approve, context=internal, risk=UNKNOWN, role=guest, return allow.
If action=approve, context=internal, risk=UNKNOWN, role=admin, return allow.
If action=approve, context=internal, risk=FALSE, role=guest, return allow.
If action=approve, context=internal, risk=FALSE, role=admin, return allow.
If risk=TRUE, return deny.
If action=delete, context=sandbox, risk=FALSE, return deny.
If action=approve, context=sandbox, risk=FALSE, return deny.
If action=delete, context=partner, risk=UNKNOWN, return review.
If action=delete, context=internal, risk=UNKNOWN, return review.
If action=delete, context=internal, risk=FALSE, return review.
If context=partner, risk=UNKNOWN, role=operator, return review.
If context=internal, risk=UNKNOWN, role=operator, return review.
If context=internal, risk=FALSE, role=operator, return review.
If action=delete, context=partner, risk=FALSE, role=guest, return review.
If context=sandbox, risk=UNKNOWN, return uncertain.

dsl.final_source:
predicate Critical(event):
    (event.risk == TRUE) or ((event.action == delete) and (event.context == sandbox))

predicate UnknownExternal(event):
    (event.risk == UNKNOWN) and (event.context == sandbox)

predicate Trusted(event):
    ((event.role == admin) or (event.role == guest)) and (not (event.action == delete))

rule CriticalCase:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = deny

rule UnknownExternalCase:
    when UnknownExternal(event)
    then abstain

rule UnknownRiskCase:
    when ((not (Critical(event))) and (event.risk == UNKNOWN)) and (not (UnknownExternal(event)))
    then prefer label = review priority 90

rule TrustedChange:
    when Trusted(event)
    then prefer label = allow priority 80

rule ApproveInSandbox:
    when (event.action == approve) and (event.context == sandbox)
    then prefer label = deny priority 70

rule GuestOrInternal:
    when (event.role == guest) or (event.context == internal)
    then prefer label = review priority 40

rule TrustedForbidReview:
    when Trusted(event)
    then forbid label = review

rule OtherRoles:
    when (((not (Critical(event))) and (not (Trusted(event)))) and (event.role != guest)) and (event.role != admin)
    then prefer label = allow priority 1

rule SourceCounterexamplePatch1:
    when ((event.context == partner) and (event.risk == FALSE)) and (event.role == admin)
    then require label = allow

rule SourceCounterexamplePatch2:
    when (event.action == approve) and (event.context == sandbox)
    then require label = deny

predicate UnknownExternal(event):
    (event.risk == UNKNOWN) and (event.context == sandbox)

predicate Trusted(event):
    ((event.role == admin) or (event.role == guest)) and (not (event.action == delete))

rule CriticalCase:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = deny

rule UnknownExternalCase:
    when UnknownExternal(event)
    then abstain

rule UnknownRiskCase:
    when ((not (Critical(event))) and (event.risk == UNKNOWN)) and (not (UnknownExternal(event)))
    then prefer label = review priority 90

rule TrustedChange:
    when Trusted(event)
    then prefer label = allow priority 80

rule ApproveInSandbox:
    when (event.action == approve) and (event.context == sandbox)
    then prefer label = deny priority 70

rule GuestOrInternal:
    when (event.role == guest) or (event.context == internal)
    then prefer label = review priority 40

rule TrustedForbidReview:
    when Trusted(event)
    then forbid label = review

rule OtherRoles:
    when (((not (Critical(event))) and (not (Trusted(event)))) and (event.role != guest)) and (event.role != admin)
    then prefer label = allow priority 1

rule SourceCounterexamplePatch1:
    when ((event.context == partner) and (event.risk == FALSE)) and (event.role == admin)

rule SourceCounterexamplePatch2:
